events.name: New York Yankees at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Will Warren pitched four-hit ball into the seventh inning, Amed Rosario and rookie Spencer Jones each homered and the New York Yankees edged the Chicago Cubs 2-0 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Will Warren dominant, Amed Rosario and Spencer Jones go deep as Yankees top Cubs 2-0

headlines.description: — Sal Stewart hit a two-run homer, had four RBI, and scored the winning run as the Cincinnati Reds rallied to beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sal Stewart hits 2-run HR, drives in 4 as Reds come back to beat Pirates 8-7

headlines.description: — Gunnar Henderson hit a two-run triple in a four-run seventh inning and the Baltimore Orioles rallied again, this time to a 6-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henderson triples in 4-run 7th in the Orioles' 6-4 win over the Phillies

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Luis Urías broke an eighth-inning tie with a two-run single and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the St. Louis Cardinals 3-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luis Urías hits tiebreaking single in 8th inning as Blue Jays beat slumping Cardinals 3-1

headlines.description: — Geraldo Perdomo and Gabriel Moreno had back-to-back RBI singles off Erik Sabrowski in a four-run eighth inning, lifting the Arizona Diamondbacks to a 4-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Diamondbacks score 4 in 8th to beat Guardians 4-1 and move into second in NL wild-card race

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Miguel Vargas, Andrew Benintendi, Munetaka Murakami and Colson Montgomery homered and the Chicago White Sox beat the American League-leading Tampa Bay Rays 6-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox hit 4 homers to cruise past the Rays 6-1

events.name: Miami Marlins at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Jakob Marsee snapped a scoreless tie with a two-run double in the fifth inning and Kyle Stowers homered for the second straight night Friday, powering the Miami Marlins to a 5-2 win over the New York Mets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jakob Marsee and Kyle Stowers lead the Marlins to a 5-2 win over the Mets

headlines.description: — Michael Harris II and Matt Olson hit long home runs and the Atlanta Braves pulled away from the Washington Nationals in a 6-2 victory on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braves blast past the Nationals 6-2 as Harris and Olson launch long home runs

headlines.description: — Yainer Diaz homered and tied a career high with four hits and Isaac Paredes and Christian Walker also went deep to lead the Houston Astros to an 11-2 rout of the Texas Rangers Friday night that put them in first place in the AL West.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yainer Diaz powers the Astros past the Rangers 11-2, pushing Houston into first

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Tomoyuki Sugano allowed a run over 6 2/3 innings to win for the seventh time in his last eight starts and the Colorado Rockies beat the Kansas City Royals 3-1 on Friday night after a
headlines.shortLinkText: Sugano helps the Rockies beat the Royals 3-1 in game delayed at start by hailstorm

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.shortLinkText: Turang, Bauers hit home runs to back Drohan's quality start in Brewers' 6-2 win over Angels

headlines.description: — Dillon Dingler hit a grand slam in Detroit's seven-run eighth inning and the Tigers opened their longest trip of the season with a 13-1 victory over the Athletics on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dillon Dingler's grand slam helps the Tigers beat A's 13-1 in Max Clark's debut

events.name: San Francisco Giants at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jake Cronenworth singled in Xander Bogaerts with two outs in the ninth inning and the San Diego Padres beat the San Francisco Giants 6-5 on Saturday night for their seventh win in eight games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cronenworth's single gives Padres 6-5 win over Giants after Miller blows save

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Ceddane Rafaela's go-ahead two-run homer highlighted a five-run seventh inning and the Boston Red Sox rallied after blowing an early lead to beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 9-4 on Friday night in the series opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rafaela has 2-run homer to spark a 5-run 7th as Red Sox rally past Dodgers, 9-4

headlines.description: — Royce Lewis hit a tying home run in the seventh inning and Luke Keaschall smacked a go-ahead double as the surging Minnesota Twins beat the Seattle Mariners 5-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lewis hits tying homer in 7th and Keaschall provides go-ahead double as Twins beat Mariners 5-3
